thread:
deploy-bot: rollout started release/rev-2026-03-15 -> staged traffic 25%

maya: getting paged — 5xx spike on hosted-inference gateway, saw surge at 12:46 UTC :rotating_light:

maya: alerting support, tagging oncall @jamie

jamie: on it, pulling traces now

jamie: quick summary: 5xxs are 502/504 at the gateway, spike correlates with rollout window (12:44-12:47)

jamie: logs snippet:```[2026-03-15T12:46:12Z] svc=inference-gateway route=hosted-infer-prod status=502 request_id=abc123 host=svc-hosted-1
[2026-03-15T12:46:13Z] svc=inference-gateway route=hosted-infer-prod status=504 request_id=abc124 host=svc-hosted-2
error=upstream-read-timeout backend=inference-runtime-quant````

ricardo: i see a config change rolled with the release: routing.signal_mode=signalized and header_batching=enabled in staged, while runtime expects header_batching=false for this model family

dan: i pushed the staged config for signal-mode earlier this morning. i didn't touch batching flag — but the rollout tooling combined two commits.

jamie: telemetry: requests with x-routing-signal header increased from 2% -> 28% in the staged slice, and those requests have much higher p50+p95 latency and 502s

tara: support ticket #4567 — customer reports their integration suddenly started getting 502s and timeouts after ~12:45. They included logs showing repeated 502s and retry storms.

maya: can we repro locally against the staged config? if it's header-related we should be able to trigger with a header-batch combo

jamie: repro steps i used (works against staged):
```bash
# simulate client requests that include the routing signal header
for i in {1..200}; do \ 
  curl -s -H "x-routing-signal: v2" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
    -d '{"input":"hi"}' \ \n    https://hosted-inference.redwood.dev/v1/generate &\ndone
```

jamie: observed 20-30% 502s locally against staged when header_batching is enabled; disabling the batching flag on the gateway fixes errors immediately in my test.

ricardo: that matches a kernel selection mismatch i saw — when header_batching=true we route into a batching codepath that expects kv-cache layout v2, but the model variant pinned in staged is still using kv-cache v1. mismatch yields upstream read timeouts.

dan: ack. initiating rollback of the staged config and will stop rollout. initiating now.

deploy-bot: rollback started for release/rev-2026-03-15 on staged slice — traffic rollback to previous config (last_known_good).

maya: monitoring... 2 minutes after rollback: 5xx rate dropping back to baseline. :white_check_mark:

tara: updated ticket #4567: root cause likely config merge that toggled signal_mode + batching without coordinated runtime variant. apologizing to customer and offering incident follow-up.

jamie: next steps: we need a preflight check in the rollout pipeline that validates batching/header flags are compatible with pinned model kv-cache version. also add a temporary guard blocking simultaneous signal_mode + batching flips.

dan: agree. i'll open a PR for the rollout pipeline check and tag infra + runtime.

ricardo: logging action item — add an explicit metric for header_batching->kernel_path mismatches so the canary alarm can trigger before 5xxs rise.

maya: cool. final status: rollback completed, customer notified, oncall handing off to SRE follow-up (jamie -> postmortem). thanks everyone. :pray:
